newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sets 80 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sets 80 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.

text.p: The Central Bank of Venezuela announced for Wednesday morning an 80-billion-bolivar auction of 179-, 268- and 358-day "monetary stabilization," or TEM, bills at nominal interest rates of up to 13.86 percent.

The bank said it would offer 40 billion bolivars worth of 179-day bills with a nominal interest rate of 13.42 percent, 20 billion bolivars of 268-day bills at 13.64 percent and 20 billion bolivars of 358-day bills at 13.86 percent.
At its auction last week the central bank sold 120 billion bolivars worth of 179-, 268- and 358-day bills with yields of 13.42 percent, 16.67 percent and 17.33 percent respectively.
